journal: Nature Astronomy (Springer Nature), Volume 10, August 2026, pp. 1208–1217, Article type "Article", Open Access (CC BY 4.0), DOI 10.1038/s41550-026-02892-9
paper_title: Ram-pressure stripping caught in action in a young cluster at z = 2.51
layout: Page 1 is a bespoke front-matter page: journal masthead ("nature astronomy" wordmark, lowercase, top-left) between two teal horizontal rule bands, orange Open Access badge top-right. Below, a metadata strip separated by thin rules: bold "Article" label left, blue hyperlinked DOI right. Title is very large bold serif (Harding-style), 2 lines, with italic math (z = 2.51) inline. Below the title the page splits asymmetrically: a narrow LEFT rail holds the article history (Received / Accepted / Published online dates, each in its own thin-rule-delimited row) plus a "Check for updates" badge; the wider RIGHT area holds the author list (bold names, green ORCID icon glyphs after most names, superscript numeric affiliation markers, envelope glyph on the corresponding author) followed by a large-type single-column abstract block set off by a rule. Numbered affiliation footnote block spans the full width at the bottom of page 1 in ~6pt type, ending with "✉ e-mail: taowang@nju.edu.cn". Body text begins two-column at the bottom third of page 1 with NO "Introduction" heading. All subsequent pages: running header "Article" (bold, left) | blue DOI URL (right) above a thin rule; footer "Nature Astronomy | Volume 10 | August 2026 | 1208–1217" (journal name in teal) left, bold folio right. Two-column body, ~8.5–9pt serif, ragged-free justified, column gutter ~5 mm, text block ~180 mm wide, margins ~17–20 mm. Heading hierarchy: A-heads bold sans-ish at slightly larger size (Results, Methods, Data availability, References, Acknowledgements...); B-heads bold at body size, may wrap ("Kinematic and star-formation properties of disturbed galaxies"). Figures float at top of page or column, either single-column or full two-column width; captions sit directly beneath the figure in small sans-serif type, spanning the same width as the figure (Fig. 3's caption runs as two columns under a full-width figure). figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.kind: Annotated astronomical sky image (JWST/NIRCam RGB composite) with WCS coordinate axes
figures.elements: Single-column raster sky image with Right Ascension / Declination axes using sexagesimal tick labels ("10 h 01 m 04 s", "2° 22′"); overlaid vector annotation layers: small orange circles (CO detections) with orange ID+redshift text labels and leader lines, red circles (RPS candidates), one solid white circle (virial radius), large dashed white circles (ALMA pointing FWHM), orange X-ray contour set; legend box top-left with semi-transparent dark background listing marker/line styles.

figures.label: Fig. 2
figures.kind: Multi-panel postage-stamp image grid + velocity-field maps (two lettered panels a/b)
figures.elements: Panel a: ~13 false-colour JWST cutout stamps in a grid (M1–M4 mergers, D1–D9 disturbed), each 5″×5″, with white CO(3–2) contour overlays at specified sigma levels, white ID label per stamp, red highlight borders around high-fidelity RPS stamps, 1″ scale bar in first stamp only, grey filled synthesized-beam ellipse in each lower-left corner. Panel b: three moment-1 velocity maps (D1, D4, D5) as pixelated red–blue diverging colormaps on greyscale background, black contours, white plus symbols (stellar centres), black fitted ellipses, hatched beam ellipses, and a horizontal colorbar under each map labelled V (km s⁻¹), −100 to 100. Bold panel letters a and b.

figures.label: Fig. 3
figures.kind: Two-panel scatter/phase-space diagram (full two-column width)
figures.elements: Panel a: scatter of r_gas/r_eff,★ vs CO(3–2) asymmetry A; red filled squares (disturbed), blue filled circles (normal), small grey markers (field), symmetric X and Y error bars (1σ), black dashed demarcation box/lines. Panel b: cluster phase-space diagram |dv/σ_c| vs dr/R_200c; diamond markers colour-coded by a third quantity via a vertical colorbar (log μ_gas/μ_gas,MS, red–blue diverging) on the right edge, grey × crosses for mergers, black solid theoretical curve, red and blue dotted contour lines with inline numeric labels (0.3, 0.5), black dashed threshold lines, legend with mixed marker+line entries, subscripted/Greek axis labels.

figures.label: Fig. 4
figures.kind: Composite statistical plots: CDF bars + radial profile with confidence bands, and a log–log scaling-relation scatter (two lettered panels a/b)
figures.elements: Panel a is itself a two-part composite sharing a Y axis: left, overlapping semi-transparent red/blue vertical bar CDF chart of Toomre Q with error bars; right, spatially resolved Q vs r/r_eff,★ with solid median lines, broad semi-transparent red/blue 1σ shaded envelopes, small scatter dots of pixel values, horizontal black dashed reference line labelled Q_thick,crit = 0.67 in an inline legend. Panel b: Kennicutt–Schmidt log–log scatter, log Σ_SFR,eff vs log Σ_gas,eff, red squares vs blue circles plus larger mean diamonds, error bars, solid best-fit/reference line, legend citing "Ref. 47". Bold panel letters, axis labels with subscripts, units in parentheses with solar-mass symbols.

caption_style: Caption begins with bold "Fig. N | " followed by a bold sentence-fragment title ending in a period ("Fig. 1 | Sky image of CLJ1001."), then regular-weight explanatory text. Panel letters referenced inside captions are set bold and lowercase ("a, CO(3–2) distributions... b, Moment-1 maps..."), and cross-caption references like "applies to all maps in b" also bold the letter. Captions are set in small sans-serif type (~7pt), placed immediately below the figure, matching the figure's column span (single-column captions in one column; the full-width Fig. 3 caption flows as two side-by-side caption columns). Captions are long and self-contained (100–220 words), including sigma levels, panel sizes, symbol meanings, error-bar definitions ("Error bars show 1σ"), and citation superscripts inside the caption text.
citation_style: Superscript numeric citations in order of appearance, hyperlinked in blue; multi-citation forms collapse ranges ("refs. 1–9", "refs. 10,11", single "ref. 14"); bare superscripts attach directly to words ("gas fractions12, compact sizes13"). Reference list is numbered 1–97, set two-column in very small type: Author, A. B. et al. Article title sentence-case. Italic journal abbreviation bold volume, page-range (year). Preprints cite arXiv URLs as blue links; software cites Zenodo DOIs. In-text cross-references to figures ("Fig. 2b", "Extended Data Fig. 4") and equations ("equation (3)") are also blue hyperlinks.
math_and_tables: Eight displayed equations, centred in-column with right-aligned parenthesized numbers (1)–(8), continuing through Methods without resetting; multi-line/stacked forms allowed (equation (5) sets two Σ definitions on shared lines). Heavy inline math: italic variables, multi-level subscripts (r_eff,gas, Σ_SFR,eff, Q_thick,crit), Greek letters (σ, Σ, μ, ρ, Ω, Λ), solar-mass/Sun symbol M⊙, operators ≈, ≳, ×, ∝, radicals and fractions inline (√(3/2)), and scientific notation (1.81 × 10⁻²² kg m⁻³). Function-style notation like log(M★/M⊙) appears constantly in running text. No tables in the main PDF; tabular material is deferred to an external "Extended Data Table 1" referenced by link.

paper_title: Detection of a four-carbon sugar in interstellar space
layout: Trim approx 210x280mm with generous (~19mm) margins. Title set very large (~28pt) in the journal's bold serif (Harding), left-aligned, max ~2 lines. Below the title a two-zone grid: a narrow left rail containing Received / Accepted / Published-online dates, each in its own thin ruled row, plus a "Check for updates" badge; the wider right zone holds the author block (bold names, inline green ORCID iD icons, superscript affiliation numbers, envelope icon on the corresponding author, ampersand before last author). The abstract is a single indented wide block (~11pt) with a heavy black rule above its left-indented column. Results > Formation mechanism on interstellar ice surfaces

figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.kind: Multi-panel radio spectral-line plot (12 spectra) with a central 3D molecular-structure inset
figures.elements: 12 lettered panels (bold lowercase a-l) in a 4+2+4+2 grid arranged AROUND a central inset: a ball-and-stick 3D render of erythrulose with blue dotted lines marking intramolecular hydrogen bonds and a text label with chemical formula (C4H8O4). Each spectral panel: observed spectrum as a black step/histogram line with light-grey fill to zero, red Gaussian LTE-fit curve for erythrulose, blue curve for the total model of all species, a boxed quantum-number label (e.g. 7_{7,1}-6_{6,1}) in the top corner, small rotated (vertical) blue text labels identifying contaminating molecular species at their frequencies, y-axis in antenna temperature with a single shared rotated y-axis label T_A* (K) spanning the grid, per-panel x-tick labels in GHz, and one shared x-axis label 'Rest frequency (GHz)' centered below the whole grid.

figures.label: Fig. 2
figures.kind: Mixed figure: 3D molecular geometry renders (top row) + Arrhenius/rate line plots (bottom row)
figures.elements: Panels a-d: rendered 3D optimized geometries of reaction complexes on an amorphous water-ice surface drawn as thin red wireframe; atoms highlighted with numbered colored circles (blue, green, purple), a curved black reaction arrow in panel c, italic short titles above each panel. Panels e-h: line plots of ln k vs 1000/T with a secondary top x-axis showing temperature in K; e and f show smooth teal/violet curves with scatter markers and in-plot legends keyed '(2) g*-e', '(3) g-e'; g shows branching-ratio percentages vs T with two series (solid teal curve + magenta dotted markers) and a two-entry legend; h shows a single dashed teal curve (ISC rate) with legend. Bold lowercase panel letters throughout.

figures.label: Fig. 3
figures.kind: Three-panel simulation time-series plot with log axes (KMC ice-abundance evolution)
figures.elements: Three side-by-side panels sharing a linear time axis (0-1.6 Myr) and a log y-axis spanning ~6 decades (10^-10 to 10^-4); each panel titled with its cosmic-ray ionization rate (zeta = 1.3x10^-17 s^-1 etc., with math). Eight colored solid lines (CO, H2O, CH3OH, glycolaldehyde, ethylene glycol, dihydroxyacetone, glyceraldehyde, erythrulose) each surrounded by a semi-transparent shaded band (+/-1 s.d. over nine random seeds); horizontal semi-transparent color-shaded ranges marking observed gas-phase values with 1-sigma widths; a dashed black line for gas density tied to a secondary right-hand log axis (n_H, cm^-3) on the rightmost panel; a color-keyed legend outside the plot area at right; shared rotated y-axis label n(X)_grain/n_H.

figures.label: Table 1
figures.kind: Journal-styled data table (derived physical parameters, 6 molecules x 6 quantities)
figures.elements: Caption above ('Table 1 | ...'), tinted header band, units row in parentheses under each column head, horizontal rules only (no vertical rules), math in heads (N, T_ex, v_LSR, FWHM, chi_obs, chi_mod with super/subscripts and x10^-10 scaling), <= symbols, +/- uncertainties, superscript letter footnote markers (a-d) resolved in small-type footnotes below the table.

figures.label: Table 2
figures.kind: Small journal-styled ratio table (4 rows, observed vs modelled abundance ratios)
figures.elements: Same Nature table styling: caption above with pipe separator, tinted header, horizontal rules, ~ and >= symbols, one-line footnote below.

figures.label: Extended Data Fig. 1
figures.kind: Dense 6x6 grid of 36 mini spectral-line panels (remaining erythrulose transitions)
figures.elements: Same graphical vocabulary as Fig. 1 at smaller scale: grey-filled black histogram spectra, red erythrulose fit, blue total-model curve, boxed quantum-number labels, rotated blue species labels, blue asterisk glyphs flagging 3mm-window transitions, shared rotated y-axis label T_A* (mK), shared x-axis label 'Rest Frequency (GHz)', heterogeneous per-panel y ranges (some panels 0-5, 0-20, 0-80 mK). Two-column caption below with bold 'Extended Data Fig. 1 |' lead-in.

figures.label: Extended Data Table 1
figures.kind: LaTeX-typeset spectroscopic table (14 transition rows) placed as an image-like block
figures.elements: Rendered in Computer Modern (visibly different from journal tables): booktabs-style top/mid/bottom rules, math column heads (J', K'_{-1}, K'_{+1} -> J'', ...), quantum-number arrows, parenthetical frequency uncertainties, bold rows highlighting 'mostly unblended' transitions, integral notation in a column head, footnote paragraph in journal small type below including inline math (sigma = rms x sqrt(delta-v x FWHM)) and a superscript note marker (a).

caption_style: Bold "Fig. N |" (and "Extended Data Fig. N |", "Table N |") label with a vertical-bar separator, followed by a bold declarative caption title sentence, then regular-weight explanatory text. Panel letters referenced in bold within the caption (e.g. "a-l," "a-d,") acting as run-in sub-labels.
